issuer: the Road Police of the Ministry of Internal Affairs (its registration and examination units)
note: Read 2026-10-30. The Law on Ensuring Road Traffic Safety (HO-166-N of 8 July 2005) in ARLIS's official incorporation in force from 30 August 2026: article 27(3) gives a licence for categories A, B and C to persons who have turned 18, and 27(8) issues the national licence for ten years (the international one for up to three). The Road Police's own answers (roadpolice.am) put a new driving licence at AMD 12,000 (the theory test's AMD 3,000 and the practical test's fees aren't the licence's and aren't held). No identity card or exchange list was read.
